answer: Admission requires agents to join a synchronized ceremony to forge a unique link between 1,000 identity keys and a verified lattice. This verifier structure maps every entry onto a shale-like ledger, ensuring that no agent can recycle credentials. An honest participant pays one unit for access, while 1,000 fakes incur a prohibitive cost. The summit of this protocol is a 90-day expiry period, mandating fresh evidence without refunds.
